title: 7 Easy DIY Costumes to Dress as Latin Music Stars on Halloween 2026
summary: From Karol G & Bruno Mars in the "Still" video to Rosalía in her LUX era, check out these simple Halloween costume ideas.
contentText:
Halloween is sneaking up on us, and with the spooky holiday only five days away, Billboard has curated a list of simple, DIY costume ideas for those last-minute shoppers.

This year’s list is inspired by a group of artists who have been all the buzz in 2026, starting with Karol G and Bruno Mars in the music video for “Still,” which is a great costume idea for couples. Another idea for couples this year includes channeling their inner-Paola Jara and Jessi Uribe — Colombia’s power couple who’s making the rounds with their joint Música Popular album, Despecho a 2 Voces . And for two friends, why not dress up as Ryan Castro and Kapo in “La Villa,” which this year is nominated at the 2026 Latin Grammys.

For those riding solo this year, you can dress up as Spanish singer/songwriter and 2026 Billboard Hall of Fame honoree Rosalía during her LUX world tour; there are many incredible outfits to choose from. Same with Aria Vega who’s been turning heads all year long with her unique Costeñita Core movement. You can also dress up as the masked Colombian newcomer, Corridos del Rey, whose viral track “Ayer Hablé Con Dios Remix” alongside Farruko ranked No. 2 on Billboard’s Best Latin Songs of 2026 mid-year list.

The 2026 Billboard Latin Music Week also served as inspiration for this year’s Halloween, such as Pitbull’s sleek look during the “Superstar Q&A With Pitbull: Chart History Live” panel.
